title: Axolotl
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF9EC4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F272A8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="headGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFB3D1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F589B4"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bellyGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE4F0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFD0E4"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M30 78 Q20 88 18 82 Q16 76 24 72 Q22 80 28 80 Z" fill="#F272A8"/>
  <path d="M70 78 Q80 88 82 82 Q84 76 76 72 Q78 80 72 80 Z" fill="#F272A8"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="26" ry="18" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>

  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="73" rx="15" ry="10" fill="url(#bellyGrad)"/>

  <!-- Back legs -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="82" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F272A8"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="82" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F272A8"/>

  <!-- Back toes -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="84" r="2" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="86" r="2" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="86" r="2" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="84" r="2" fill="#FFB3D1"/>

  <!-- Front legs -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="70" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#F589B4"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="70" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#F589B4"/>

  <!-- Front toes -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="71" r="1.8" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="73" r="1.8" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="73" r="1.8" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="71" r="1.8" fill="#FFB3D1"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="28" ry="22" fill="url(#headGrad)"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="50" r="6" fill="#FF8FC0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="50" r="6" fill="#FF8FC0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="42" rx="5" ry="5.5" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="42" rx="5" ry="5.5" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="40.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="40.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M44 52 Q50 57 56 52" stroke="#D45A8A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Gills (3 on each side) -->
  <!-- Left gills -->
  <path d="M22 36 Q10 24 6 28 Q14 28 18 38" fill="#FF6BAA" stroke="#FF6BAA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M20 43 Q6 36 2 42 Q12 40 18 46" fill="#FF6BAA" stroke="#FF6BAA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M22 50 Q8 52 6 58 Q14 52 20 54" fill="#FF6BAA" stroke="#FF6BAA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Right gills -->
  <path d="M78 36 Q90 24 94 28 Q86 28 82 38" fill="#FF6BAA" stroke="#FF6BAA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M80 43 Q94 36 98 42 Q88 40 82 46" fill="#FF6BAA" stroke="#FF6BAA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M78 50 Q92 52 94 58 Q86 52 80 54" fill="#FF6BAA" stroke="#FF6BAA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Gill frills (lighter tips) -->
  <circle cx="6" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="2" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="6" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="94" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="98" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <circle cx="94" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>

  <!-- Head fin (top crest) -->
  <path d="M50 23 Q48 18 52 16 Q54 20 52 23" fill="#FF9EC4"/>
</svg>
